import.skipped: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} without a date skipped (like the totals row).
import.errors: {count, plural, one {# line has} other {# lines have}} values that aren't numbers (counted as zero).
import.tooMany: The file has more days than the limit; we imported the first {max} only.

import.replaceNote: Days this channel already has numbers for will be replaced by the file's.
